selected_mechanism: Candidate only: collectively enacted participation creates value despite unfavorable aesthetic judgments, while exhibitors enable or constrain access.
explanatory_gain: Directs inquiry toward participation and intermediary decisions; the supplied account does not establish causality or novelty relative to a complete literature review.

evidence_coverage.N3: Exhibitor disagreement motivates an access boundary.
evidence_coverage.N4: Memes and participatory responses motivate the conjecture but do not establish typical motives.

observations_against: Interviewed purchasers do not value shared participation.
Comparable visibility and access explain purchasing without participation differences.

prospective_transfer_predictions.claim: In a new comparison with similar awareness and access, variation in opportunities for shared participation should correspond to participation-oriented purchaser motives if the proposed mechanism operates.
Where intermediaries withhold access, attention and participation should translate less readily into realized attendance, conditional on comparable demand.

residual_anomalies: Purchaser motives, temporal ordering, and the role of supply are not identified.
Polarized platform ratings may reflect different audiences or ironic responding.
No independent transfer evidence is available.
